thread:
Anya Patel: Quick intake — we have a request to onboard Orchid-7B (open checkpoint) for inference. Thinking: run quant experiments (8-bit, 4-bit q4f), parity evals vs gpt-3.5 on our perp/chat suites, and a staged rollout. Who wants to own the bring-up checklist?
Matt R: I can lead quant experiments. propose: baseline FP16 -> q8 -> q4, compare lat/cost/quality.
Sarah L: I can handle the eval harness and create prompt sets. Need alignment on which eval buckets matter (summarization, instruction-following, math, toxicity).
Devon C: I can add model entry into catalog once we have perf numbers and config. Also need recommended default config (batching, kv cache warmup).
Micah J: Heads-up on infra: Orchid's tokenizer is a bit weird — might need tokenization patch for streaming. I can prototype.
Priya K: Product/marketing check — if performance looks decent, we'll want a short announcement on the hosted catalog + release notes. Timeline?
Anya Patel: Thanks. Proposed priority: 1) eval parity (quality gating), 2) quant cost/lat tradeoffs, 3) infra integration, 4) catalog + announcement. Can we hit a rough 2-week cadence for initial results?
Matt R: 2 weeks for initial q8/q4 evals sounds feasible. I'll spin up runs today. cc @ops-bot for job scheduling.
ops-bot: Job submitted: quant-run-1749994321-01 -> queued on train-gpu-pool. ETA 4h.
Sarah L: I'll start curating prompt sets. Quick Q: do we include our internal convo-regression suite? it caught issues for M-xyz previously.
Anya Patel: yes include convo-regression and the production prompt set. Also add a subset of user prompts (anonymized) for pragmatic checks.
Devon C: For the catalog entry skeleton I need: model id, family, license, max-seq, tokenizer notes, supported quant modes, recommended cfg. I'll draft a template.
Micah J: Early note: q4 leads to tokenization alignment differences on prefix caching; we should measure generation determinism. Add tests for identical seeds across quant modes.
Matt R: plan: run evals across fp16, q8_0, q4f, q4_8. Metrics: accuracy-based (task-specific), perplexity, avg latency @1/4/16 batch, tokens/sec, cost/token. I'll post the run matrix in a doc.
Priya K: For announcement: we need one experiment that shows latency/cost delta vs our default hosted model and copy for product. I can draft messaging once you share numbers. timeline: aim for small catalog note in week after initial results.
Sarah L: checklist I'm assembling: 
- [ ] Eval harness: convo-regression, summarization, math, toxicity, hallucination prompts
- [ ] A/B reranking tests vs rdefault
- [ ] Human review for top 50 sampled responses
- [ ] Auto-metrics and threshold gating (fail if >X delta)
I'll attach scripts to the eval repo.
Anya Patel: Great. Also add rollout policy: canary on Dedicated 1% -> 10% -> 50% with fallback to rdefault model. Ops to set automated fallback if error rate >2% or p95 latency regresses >20%.
Devon C: For catalog: draft fields added: "redwood_model_id", "upstream_checkpoint", "licenses", "quant_supported": "q8,q4f", "recommended_flags": "--cache-warmup=200 --batcher=auto". Will fill specifics after we have perf numbers.
Matt R: pushing first q8 job logs: 
```
> qrun --model orchid-7b --mode q8 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --out /tmp/qruns/174999
[INFO] loaded weights -> 12.3GB
[INFO] tokens/sec: 340
[INFO] p50 latency: 45ms
```
Sarah L: nice. can you add eval-snapshot id to the run so we can tie metrics to run?
Matt R: done -> eval-snap: orchid-q8-174999-a
Micah J: Found tokenizer mismatch on one sample — sending patch to repo. We should re-run streaming test after merge.
ops-bot: Patch merged: tokenizer-fix #422. CI triggered.
Anya Patel: Decisions: Matt leads quant; Sarah leads eval; Devon implements catalog entry; Micah infra fixes; Priya handles announcement copy. Owners — please update the onboarding checklist doc with expected deliverables and slas.
Priya K: If we make the hosted catalog, we'll need a short note in the Console release notes and a banner for the model page. I'll coordinate with design.
Devon C: Once perf numbers are in I'll propose a default serving config and a canary name (orchid-stable / orchid-canary).
Sarah L: I'll add a human-eval step: sample 200 responses across tasks, tag wants_followup/hallucination. We should set a quality gate (e.g., no more than 5% hallucination delta vs baseline).
Matt R: rough ETA for initial matrix: 36h for q8+eval; extra 2 days for q4 runs and human sampling.
Anya Patel: timeline acknowledged. I'll set a sync on Friday 10am to review results and decide announcement. Thanks everyone. :tada:
Micah J: One more infra note — for Private deployments we should include a quant profile (mixed-precision) option in the catalog so customers can opt in. Adding to catalog task.
Priya K: tagging legal for license check — Orchid is Apache-2.0? can someone confirm upstream license?
Devon C: upstream lists Apache-2.0. I'll add license field.
Anya Patel: Perfect. Closing the intake here — update the checklist doc as you progress. Friday sync link: https://meet.example.com/rdw-onboard-sync
Devon C: added initial catalog draft -> https://docs.redwood.ai/models/orchid-7b/draft
Matt R: uploaded q8/raw metrics -> s3://redwood-eval/orchid/174999/q8/
